violations.why: Meadow ISR is enabled at line 17 and can preempt between the check and the reset, so its increment is overwritten by the reset.
Once meadow has run, it enables ISR 2 globally, so vessel can preempt the task between the check and the reset.
Before the interrupts are masked at line 16, ISRs can modify v_lantern after the task's write, so the task's read at line 18 sees a different value than it wrote.
After ISR 2 is enabled, vessel (higher priority) can preempt a later meadow run in the middle of v_lantern++, and its update is lost.
